title: Premature Fixed Deposit Withdrawal
content: For premature fixed deposit withdrawal, verify the FD account number and authenticate the customer using registered mobile OTP plus one identity document. Recalculate interest for the completed tenure at the applicable card rate for that tenure, which may be lower than the booked rate. For retail deposits below INR 2 crore, apply a 1.00% premature closure penalty by reducing the applicable rate. Share the net payout before taking consent. Capture written consent or digital OTP consent, close the deposit in CBS, credit proceeds to the linked savings account, and provide a closure receipt in the customer's preferred language.

title: Savings Account Opening Requirements
content: For new savings account opening, identify the account variant: Regular Savings, Salary, Student, or Senior Citizen. Mandatory documents are PAN, Aadhaar or another officially valid document for identity and address, one passport-size photograph if the branch scanner is unavailable, mobile number, email if available, nominee details, and initial deposit if required by the selected account variant. Perform in-person verification, complete the account opening form in CBS, explain minimum balance and charges, offer mobile banking and UPI registration, and provide the account number and branch IFSC in writing.

title: Debit and Credit Card Replacement Procedure
content: For card replacement, verify customer identity with PAN and registered mobile OTP. Confirm card type, associated account, and last four digits if available. Generate the replacement request in CBS. Disclose the replacement fee before submission: INR 200 for Visa Classic debit or credit cards and INR 500 for Visa Platinum debit or credit cards. Expected delivery is 7 to 10 business days to the registered address. Provide temporary virtual card guidance if available in mobile banking and record the request ID.

title: Transaction Dispute and Fraud Reporting
content: If fraud is suspected, block the card immediately after customer authentication. Record disputed transaction date, amount, merchant, channel, and complaint narrative. File the complaint in the CBS dispute module and generate a complaint reference number. Inform the customer that investigation may take up to 90 days. Explain that zero liability applies when unauthorized electronic banking transactions are reported within 3 working days, subject to regulatory and bank policy conditions. Schedule a follow-up within 7 business days.

title: Personal Loan Enquiry Guardrails
content: For a personal loan enquiry, capture income, employment type, requested loan amount, purpose, and existing EMI obligations. Check pre-approved eligibility in CBS if the customer is existing. Indicative rates are 10.49% to 16.00% per annum for salaried applicants and 11.49% to 18.00% per annum for self-employed applicants, subject to credit assessment. Disclose processing fee of 1.00% to 2.00% of loan amount plus applicable taxes. Required documents include salary slips or income proof, ITR where applicable, bank statements, PAN, identity proof, and address proof. Do not promise approval; always say approval is subject to credit assessment.
